messages.subject: mirtCAT image response options
parts:
Hello Phil-
Thanks again for making these packages. They are fantastic. I see the wiki example for putting images in the item stem, but I tried to make an example with images in the response options. It didn't work though. Is that an option? Is there a way to include image response options? Thanks,
Aaron

messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: Re: mirtCAT image response options
parts:
Hi Aaron,

Such things are possible in mirtCAT, though I haven't found the time to make all possible permutation options obvious on the wiki (contributions welcome!). You can find this behaviour here: https://github.com/philchalmers/mirtCAT/tree/master/tests/GUI-tests, starting on line 57 of the file GUI-tests.R. Basically, you would create customized stems for your respective items, and use HTML tags to point to the image files you want for that corresponding option input. It's a bit more low-level compared to the more R-driven package components, but then the task itself is a bit on the low level end too so I suppose it's fitting. HTH.

Phil
